gaps.sentence: Nowhere ___ the report mention the missing funds.
gaps.explanation: Nowhere does the report mention… — present simple inversion.

gaps.sentence: Only in an emergency ___ this exit be used.
gaps.explanation: may + be + participle: this exit may be used only in an emergency.

gaps.sentence: Rarely ___ we seen such dedication from a new recruit.
gaps.explanation: 'Rarely have we seen' — inversion with present perfect, experience up to now.

gaps.sentence: Only by training every day ___ she hope to qualify.
gaps.explanation: 'Only by training every day could she hope …' — inverted modal.

gaps.sentence: ___ had I hung up than the phone rang again.
gaps.explanation: 'No sooner had I hung up than …' — the fixed inverted pair.

gaps.sentence: No sooner ___ the contract been signed than problems arose.
gaps.explanation: Past perfect passive with inversion: had … been signed.

gaps.sentence: At no point ___ the pilot leave the cockpit.
gaps.explanation: At no point did… = never did… — negative adverbial inversion.

gaps.sentence: Not until every passenger had been evacuated ___ the captain leave the ship.
gaps.explanation: 'Not until … did the captain leave …' — inverted past simple.
